rgb(17, 24, 39);color: rgb(255, 255, 255);font-family: &quot;Avenir Next&quot;, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 10px;font-weight: 700;letter-spacing: 1px;padding: 3px 7px;line-height: 1.3;"><span leaf="">VIDEO 02</span></span><p style="margin: 0px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 700;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);line-height: 1.4;"><span leaf="">Kimi K3.1 Pro · 太空电梯</span></p></section><section style="border-width: 1px 1px medium;border-style: solid solid none;border-color: rgb(229, 231, 235) rgb(229, 231, 235) currentcolor;border-image: none;line-height: 0;"><section nodeleaf=""><iframe class="video_iframe rich_pages" data-src="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/mp/readtemplate?t=pages/video_player_tmpl&amp;action=mpvideo&amp;auto=0&amp;vid=wxv_4750960747827200002" data-mpvid="wxv_4750960747827200002" data-vidtype="2" data-cover="http%3A%2F%2Fmmbiz.qpic.cn%2Fsz_mmbiz_jpg%2FiaZPxh36Uvuz9pLM7FY7lUb2mEz4BzjVYvgFMQCpicRibqvtMXQL4hUQfQxjqS5n4ee3t3ic0icegRvjsHXHYaPSvlZvxCcYmxbY5O8FEppibHUcs%2F0%3Fwx_fmt%3Djpeg" inline-block;background: rgb(17, 24, 39);color: rgb(255, 255, 255);font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace;font-size: 10px;font-weight: 700;padding: 2px 8px;border-radius: 12px;letter-spacing: 1px;"><span leaf="">PROMPT</span></span><span style="font-size: 11px;color: rgb(107, 114, 128);font-weight: 700;"><span leaf="">天地之间.txt · 上下滑动查看 ↕</span></span></section><section style="height: 320px;overflow-y: scroll;padding: 14px 16px 8px;"><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">用 WebGL2 + Three.js r160 做一段受《流浪地球 2》太空电梯启发的实时交互航程《天地之间》。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【核心要求】保留影片的重工业巨构感：密集桁架、运输舱、垂直导向结构、轨道枢纽。先从地面人的视角建立压迫感，再随运输舱升空，最后看到地球曲率和轨道设施。不要做成带底座的微缩沙盘。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【第一帧】登乘平台边缘：前景是磨损的栏杆和两名工作人员，中景是待命的运输舱，巨大的导向结构从画外一直延伸进云里。暖色工作灯、冷灰金属、潮湿地面和远处车辆做比例参照。标题"天地之间"只占一角，主按钮"开始升空"。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 9px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 800;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【四个连续区域】</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 地面基地：海上基地锚定结构、装卸平台、检修栈桥、道路、货箱、护栏，至少三种地面车辆；人、门、栏杆尺度一致</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 运输舱：分段蒙皮、窗和可见的 2–3 层内舱、舱门、导向连接、缓冲和锁止机构</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 上升段：导向结构节段、层次不同的云、逐渐变薄的大气。云有进出和遮挡，不是一张白面片</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 轨道枢纽：桁架、停靠槽、转运区、太阳能 / 散热构件、两类辅助飞行器、至少一套能工作的机械臂。地球、云系、昼夜线程序化生成</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【比例】以舱高 H = 12 米为基准：舱宽约 0.65H、长约 1.6H，舱门净高约 0.18H，人高约 1.75 米，栈桥宽约 0.15H。优先级：舱体剪影和垂直走向 &gt; 舱门、导向、锁止、机械臂 &gt; 蒙皮紧固件和磨损。不能靠把人缩小来制造宏大感。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 9px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 800;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【机构】</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 导向组件：固定框 + 带轴套的连接臂 + 导向轮或滑块，伸缩杆长度由两端距离决定</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 锁止机构：导入斜面、缓冲行程、成对锁爪、状态灯，灯随锁爪的真实位置变化</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 机械臂只在运输舱运动范围外作业，转运货物要经过抓取、离架、平移、入位、松爪</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 地面栈桥和枢纽栈桥属于各自区域，不能跟着运输舱一起飞上去</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【六阶段航程】总时长 100–140 秒</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">1. 0–15% 平台准备：低机位仰望，货物装入，舱门关闭，栈桥撤离，锁止解除</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">2. 15–32% 出发加速：镜头跟随，近处结构形成视差，基地逐渐变小</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">3. 32–50% 进入云层：云和水汽掠过舱窗，镜头短暂进入舱内，看到同一片外部场景</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">4. 50–70% 冲出云海（全片高潮）：此前镜头贴近舱壁，冲出云顶后视野第一次打开，太阳侧光、地球曲率和稀薄大气同时出现</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">5. 70–90% 抵近枢纽：减速、对齐，轨道设施逐层进入画面</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">6. 90–100% 捕获锁定：缓冲、锁止、停稳后接栈桥；镜头从舱窗拉远，运输舱、枢纽和地球同框</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【状态约束】舱门关好、栈桥撤离后才能出发；捕获前要减速对齐；锁止完成后才接栈桥。倒拖进度条时，机构、灯光、相机和环境都要回到该进度对应的状态，不能只倒放舱体。地面、上升段和行星背景分层处理，切换时不能跳变、地球突然变大或舱体抖动。航程距离可以压缩，但要在 README 里说明是示意。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 9px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 800;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【交互】</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 三种模式：电影航程、舱内观察、自由观察。进入舱内或自由观察时暂停航程并保留进度，返回后接着播</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 一条总进度条，可暂停、拖动、倒退查看</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 六个热点：舱门、导向组件、锁止器、缓冲结构、转运机械臂、枢纽桁架，点击后镜头聚焦并显示简短用途</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- "无云结构检查"开关，方便看清尺度和接缝</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【材质、光和声音】色板：工程白 #C6CBC9、钢灰 #59636C、深舱黑 #171E26、警示橙 #D97735、工作灯暖白 #FFD6A0、云白 #E8EAE7、大气蓝 #6EA8C8、太空黑 #05090F。金属靠粗糙度、加工纹、接缝和磨损区分；舱窗能看出厚度和里面的内舱。太阳是唯一稳定的主光，方向随高度连续变化。声音用 Web Audio 合成：低频动力声、舱门和锁止声、舱内环境声；进入太空后舱外不加呼啸风声。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【平面素材】可以用生图模型生成一张三联构图板（地面仰视 / 冲出云顶 / 轨道远景），只用来定画面，不当背景；再生成一张可平铺的工程白漆面纹理。导轨槽、门缝和锁爪必须是几何，不从贴图里伪造。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【交付】一个完整的 index.html，所有代码和采用的图片都内嵌，Chrome 双击打开、断网可用。目标 1920×1080 下 60 FPS，提供高 / 标准 / 低三档画质。支持暂停、复位、隐藏 UI、静音，触屏有等效操作。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【验收】必须能展示六个机位：地面仰视、舱门与导向近景、穿云中间态、云顶拉远、枢纽抵近、地球远景。完整跑两遍航程，在 10%、35%、55%、80%、95% 来回拖动，舱门、栈桥、锁止和镜头都不跳状态；自由模式返回后进度不重置；关掉云雾仍能看懂巨构。失败条件：电梯和导向结构脱离、栈桥穿过舱体、没减速就锁定、用一根细线加普通盒子代替主体、镜头跳尺度、只换天空颜色冒充升空。</span></p></section></section></section></section><section style="padding: 0px inline-block;background: rgb(17, 24, 39);color: rgb(255, 255, 255);font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace;font-size: 10px;font-weight: 700;padding: 2px 8px;border-radius: 12px;letter-spacing: 1px;"><span leaf="">PROMPT</span></span><span style="font-size: 11px;color: rgb(107, 114, 128);font-weight: 700;"><span leaf="">猛禽发动机.txt · 上下滑动查看 ↕</span></span></section><section style="height: 320px;overflow-y: scroll;padding: 14px 16px 8px;"><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">用 WebGL2 + Three.js r160 做一个可环绕、剖切、分解、追踪流路、观察推力矢量摆动的实时 3D 工程展示《星舰猛禽发动机：从管路到推力》。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【核心要求】主角是一台完整的外露机械式猛禽发动机：上部是密集但有秩序的泵组、阀件和管线，中部是紧凑的燃烧室和收缩喉部，下部是展开的钟形喷管。保留粗细管道交织、非对称设备分布、承重框和侧向执行杆这些识别特征。这是甲烷 / 液氧全流量分级燃烧的教学示意，不虚构精确推力、室压、温度、混合比或点火时序，运行强度一律显示为示意百分比。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【第一帧】略低的三分之四前视，整台发动机完整入画。左前方宽光划过喷管，右后方细轮廓光把管线和深灰背景分开。默认不喷火，主入口"探索发动机"，旁边是"观看工作原理"，一进来就能转模型。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【比例】以顶部安装面到喷管出口的总高 H = 100 为基准</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 上部设备与承重框约 0.33H：左右不完全对称的泵壳、立式筒体、横梁和管路</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 燃烧室到喉部约 0.2H：上鼓下收，收缩明显</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 喷管约 0.47H：连续曲率的钟形，出口直径 0.5–0.6H，出口是开放内腔，带薄唇口</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 执行机构单侧略超出主体轮廓：斜杆、轴套、上下铰座清楚先锁定"紧凑机械头部—收缩颈部—宽口喷管"的轮廓，再加功能设备，最后补紧固件。喷管不能用直圆锥，设备区不能用随机圆柱团；管线之间保留真实间隙，背面不能镜像复制正面。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 9px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 800;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【结构】</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 顶部承重框有厚度和连接耳，泵组和燃烧室通过支架挂在框上，不悬浮在管线上</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 燃料侧、氧化剂侧两套独立泵组：泵壳、叶轮、轴、涡轮、预燃室。泵和涡轮同轴共转，外壳不转；两侧转速各自独立</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 燃烧室有内外壁和喷注端面，冷却通道作为室壁夹层，剖切时才露出来</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 线束沿框边成束走线，用卡箍固定，不能像藤蔓一样乱缠</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【流路】先定义节点和有向连接，管道外观、粒子、标签和二维示意图都从同一份数据生成</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">1. 液态甲烷进燃料泵增压，一条冷却支路经过室壁 / 喷管冷却层后回到燃料流路</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">2. 大部分燃料加少量氧化剂进燃料富集预燃室，产生的燃气驱动涡轮后进入主喷注端</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">3. 液氧进氧化剂泵，大部分氧化剂加少量燃料进氧富集预燃室，驱动涡轮后进入主喷注端</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">4. 两股燃气在主燃烧室燃烧，经喉部从喷管排出这是闭式循环，不能画成涡轮排气直接排到外面。配色：燃料浅黄、富燃燃气暖橙、液氧浅蓝、富氧燃气青蓝、燃烧产物暖红。关闭的管段必须停止粒子。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 9px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 800;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【五种模式】</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 整机观察：拖动环绕、滚轮缩放，提供正面 / 侧面 / 背面 / 喷口 / 主视角按钮</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 局部剖切：燃料泵、氧化剂泵、燃烧室、喷管可以分别剖开，滑杆调切入深度，切口要有壁厚，不能露出空壳</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 流路追踪：点入口或任意节点，逐段高亮上下游；可切换单路、双路、冷却支路，可单步前进、后退</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 分解装配：用 0–1 的进度驱动，先挪开遮挡的辅助件，再横向展开泵组，最后沿轴向分离喷注端、燃烧室和喷管。反向拖动沿原路装回并精确复位；分解时停止流动</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 运行演示：只能在装配状态下运行，分解状态下点运行要先自动装回去。展示循环建立、稳定运行、减弱、停止</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【推力矢量】绕上部摆动中心做两轴各 ±4° 的摆动（演示限位）。两组执行杆连接固定侧和发动机，每帧按两端位置计算方向和长度，到行程边界就限位。已喷出的粒子按出生时的方向继续飞，不能跟着发动机像硬棍一样转。分解时禁止摆动。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【自动导览】80–110 秒，五段：认识整机 → 建立流路 → 剖切解释循环 → 稳定运行示意 → 停止与回看。时间轴可以拖动；"暂停"和"停止运行"是两回事。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【环境、材质和声音】深灰工业检查空间，上方有吊架，侧面有检修平台；发动机下方是开放的测试井，喷流向井内延伸并衰减，不穿过地板。喷流用有厚度的体积加少量短寿命粒子，不用火焰照片贴片。色板：缎面钢 #AAB0B2、深金属 #353B40、暖灰 #77746D、隔热暗灰 #262B30，少量热影响蓝紫和棕金。不要满机镀铬，也不要通体一种灰。温度视图是独立模式，标注"相对热状态示意"，退出后恢复原材质。声音用 Web Audio 合成：低频运行声、泵组层次、阀门动作声；剖切和分解时不发爆炸声。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【平面素材】可以用生图模型生成可平铺的缎面钢纹理、局部热影响色贴花和一张灯光参考图。流路、文字、接口位置和运动几何全部由代码控制，不能用照片代替发动机主体。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【交付】一个完整的 index.html，所有代码和采用的图片都内嵌，Chrome 双击打开、断网可用。目标 1920×1080 下 60 FPS，提供高 / 标准 / 低三档画质。支持暂停、复位、隐藏 UI、静音，触屏有等效操作。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 9px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 800;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【验收】</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">1. 无雾、无喷流状态下看六个固定机位（三分之四整机、侧面、背面管路、双泵顶部、燃烧室喉部、喷管内腔）：轮廓、出口厚度、非对称布局都在，背面没有大面积缺失</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">2. 依次追踪燃料、氧化剂、冷却三条路径；关掉一段，箭头、粒子和说明同步更新</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">3. 剖切时转子在转、外壳不转；喷管剖面能分清外壁、冷却层、内壁和内腔</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">4. 分解进度在 0 / 25 / 50 / 75 / 100% 之间往返，连续装配十次不漂移</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">5. 摆动到正负极限和四个对角，执行杆始终连着，刚性管不被拉长</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">6. 运行演示完整跑两轮，在各阶段暂停、拖动，声音不重复，粒子不无限增长失败条件：一个圆锥加随机管线冒充发动机、内部空壳、喷口封死、管道没有起止点、泵壳跟着转子一起转、分解后还在满负荷喷火、执行杆脱节、图片代替主体几何。</span></p></section></section></section></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span leaf="">最头疼的是太密，泵、管子、燃烧室全挤在一起。所以它拆成五种模式，</span><span style="background: linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 58%, rgb(252, 231, 166) 58%);padding: 0px 2px;font-weight: 600;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);"><span leaf="">一次只看一件事</span></span><span leaf="">。模式之间的状态也是连着的：拆开的时候点运行，它会先装回去再启动；关掉一段管子，别的支路还会接着流</span></p></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><section style="margin: 30px 0px 12px;"><section style="display: flex;align-items: inline-block;background: rgb(17, 24, 39);color: rgb(255, 255, 255);font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace;font-size: 10px;font-weight: 700;padding: 2px 8px;border-radius: 12px;letter-spacing: 1px;"><span leaf="">PROMPT</span></span><span style="font-size: 11px;color: rgb(107, 114, 128);font-weight: 700;"><span leaf="">纸上生长.txt · 上下滑动查看 ↕</span></span></section><section style="height: 320px;overflow-y: scroll;padding: 14px 16px 8px;"><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">用 WebGL2 + Three.js r160 做一本可以亲手打开、翻页、合上的 3D 立体书《纸上生长》。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【核心要求】书页展开时，树木、房屋、桥梁沿纸艺机关逐层立起，能看见纸片和底页的连接；合上时收回书页之间。"生长"必须靠折叠结构实现，不能让模型从地面缩放长出来。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【第一帧】暖色书桌上一本深绿布面精装书，封面烫金"纸上生长"，书脊有织物纹理，书口和书签可见。点击封面或拖动封面边缘开书，镜头从封面慢慢移到纸页侧面，看第一组机关被拉起。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【三个跨页】每页至少 12 个核心纸构件、三层进深，至少两组由开书角度驱动的机关</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">1. 种子森林（主动作：树冠展开）：中心大树多层折片展开，前景草丛、中景树干、后景林冠；一条折纸小溪穿过书脊，纸鹿和沿纸槽移动的纸鸟做尺度参照。叶片保留剪纸镂空。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">2. 桥上的小城（主动作：桥跨起、房屋立起）：左页沿岸房屋、右页钟楼，中间折桥跨过溪道；四座房屋各有立面和屋顶，桥面分段随开合改变夹角。不能左右各放半座城却收不起来。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">3. 夜晚的花园（主动作：花瓣层层打开）：三层主花、三朵次花、细枝、镂空月轮、小亭；冷蓝背景配暖色纸灯，光点只做点缀，不能变成发光粒子页。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【风格与比例】精致手工纸雕 + 丝网印刷：纸有厚度，剪纸边，色块轻微套印偏差。三页共用纸张、线条和人物比例，变化来自构图和主机关。单页宽 240mm，页高约 1.2 倍页宽；主机关展开高度约为页宽的 0.4–0.6，不超出页边。色板：纸白 #F2E7CE、布面绿 #24483E、森林绿 #69825A、泥土赭 #AA7450、城墙暖灰 #C3AD87、屋顶红 #AA574B、夜空靛 #283D62、印金 #C6A365。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 9px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 800;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【机关与状态】</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 区分三个角度：整本书开合角 θ（0° 闭合、180° 平展）、活动页翻转角 φ、每个机关两侧底页的实际夹角 α。机关姿态按 α 解算，不直接读开合滑杆。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 主机关用 V-fold 和平行折，房屋可用盒式立起，轻交互用滑槽拉片。先做一个 V-fold 树干和一间平行折房屋，验证铰线、连接片和折叠方向，再扩展到三页。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 每个大构件分配独立的收纳空间：树冠错层、屋顶折回墙面、花瓣分层合拢。合书时不能把机关缩小、压扁或直接隐藏。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 翻页顺序：先收回拉片 → 活动页抬起，带动旧机关折叠 → 越过书脊前进入收纳 → 新跨页随夹角增大展开。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 9px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 800;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【交互】</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 开合：拖动封面或角度滑杆，随时可以停下从侧面检查</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 翻页：前一页 / 后一页 / 拖页角。拖过一半完成翻页，不到一半沿原路退回；动画进行中最多记一个下一步，不堆无限队列</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 观察：环绕、缩放、书桌全景、纸边微距、进入书中。在书中视角下翻页，先退回书桌视角再翻</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 拉片：森林页让纸鸟移动，小城页改变桥的角度，花园页展开纸花；合书前自动收回</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 4px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">- 自动导览：依次打开三页、停留、翻页、合书，70–100 秒，可暂停、重播</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【镜头与光】每页三种构图：书在桌上的全景、机关正在打开的侧视、进入纸艺世界的低机位。三者用同一套模型连续移动，不能切到另一个场景。左上方宽柔光做主光，纸片之间有清楚的接触阴影；只有花园的纸灯用暖光。翻页声和折纸声用 Web Audio 合成，可静音。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【平面素材】可以用生图模型生成三组透明背景的平面印刷素材（森林、小城、花园元素，正面平铺，无透视、无投影、无文字）。折线、铰点、厚度和收纳结构全部用代码建立；标题、页码等文字由代码排版。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【交付】一个完整的 index.html，所有代码和采用的图片都内嵌，Chrome 双击打开、断网可用。目标 1920×1080 下 60 FPS，提供高 / 标准 / 低三档画质。支持暂停、复位、隐藏 UI、静音，触屏有等效操作。</span></p><p style="margin: 0px 0px 12px;font-size: 12px;font-weight: 500;color: rgb(75, 85, 99);line-height: 1.85;text-align: justify;font-family: Menlo, Consolas, &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, monospace;overflow-wrap: anywhere;"><span leaf="">【验收】开书到 60° 时拉片再合书；在书中视角请求下一页；翻页到 40% 取消、到 60% 松手；连续快速点前后页；三页往返加合书跑 10 轮。以上都不能出现连接片断开、旧页提前消失、相机卡在合拢的书页里。失败条件：缩放长出物体、平面图片冒充立体机关、纸片穿页、合书后凸出封面、反向操作时构件消失、进入书中偷换场景、三页只换了颜色。</span></p></section></section></section></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span leaf="">大家可以看下，我觉得还是做的挺有趣，这个</span><span style="color: rgb(17, 24, 39);font-weight: 700;"><span leaf="">最难的不是展开，是合上</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="26" height="18" viewbox="0 0 26 18" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:-4px;margin:0 3px;"><path d="M13 4L3 5.5V16L13 14.5Z" fill="#F3F4F6" style="display: flex;align-items: flex-start;gap: 10px;margin: 28px 0px 16px;"><span style="display: inline-block;width: 6px;height: 6px;background: rgb(4, 120, 87);flex-shrink: 0;margin-top: 10px;line-height: 0;font-size: 0px;"><span leaf=""><br  /></span></span><p style="margin: 0px;font-size: 15px;font-weight: 800;color: rgb(17, 24, 39);line-height: 1.9;"><span style="background: rgb(211, 241, 226);padding: 2px 4px;"><span leaf="">六个 case 跑下来，说下我的整体感受</span></span></p></section></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span style="background: rgb(211, 241, 226);color: rgb(17, 24, 39);padding: 0px 2px;"><span leaf="">3D 这块 Kimi K3.1 Pro 确实上了一个台阶</span></span><span leaf="">，立体书、提花机这种，一段提示词就能出完整能玩的东西，太空电梯、打字机这种状态复杂的，它还会自己写测试验证逻辑</span></p></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span leaf="">跟 Opus 5.5 比，画面和细节还有差距，这个得承认，但</span><span style="color: rgb(17, 24, 39);font-weight: bold;border-bottom: 2px solid rgb(242, 207, 91);padding-bottom: 1px;"><span leaf="">花费差了 6 倍</span></span><span leaf="">，权重还开源，这笔账很好算</span></p></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span leaf="">再说个现实的，最近 Astra 被一堆人吐槽降智，Claude 在国内动不动封号，好用的闭源模型，要么不稳定，要么用不上</span></p></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span leaf="">这种时候，一个用得上、用得起、能力又在第一梯队的国产模型就特别珍贵，就目前来说，Kimi K3.1 Pro 是我心里的国模一哥，日常写代码、做 3D，完全可以用起来</span></p></section><section style="padding: 0px 12px;"><p style="margin: 0px 0px 16px;font-size: 14px;line-height: 1.9;text-align: justify;"><span leaf="">开头说这时候需要一个模型提提气，这次 Kimi</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="60" height="22" viewbox="0 0 60 22"
